description: Figure 6 is a pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" that visually represents the breakdown of token resolution for the FedHLM framework. The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each corresponding to a different resolution stage. The largest segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL," accounts for 94.5% of all tokens, indicating that the vast majority are resolved locally at the client side. The second segment, colored red and labeled "EDGE_P2P," represents 3.9% of tokens, signifying those resolved through peer-to-peer exchanges between edge clusters. The smallest segment, colored blue and labeled "LLM," constitutes 1.6% of tokens, representing those forwarded to the centralized Large Language Model for final resolution. The chart effectively illustrates that FedHLM primarily relies on local inference, with minimal reliance on external P2P or centralized LLM resources.
